title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicles as Mediators of Anti-Inflammatory Effects: Endorsement of Macrophage Polarization.
species: mouse (in vivo); human adipose MSC, mouse BM macrophages

limitation.zh: 无EV货物敲降或巨噬细胞清除的因果实验；功能学（力量）终点缺失。
limitation.en: No cargo knockdown or macrophage-depletion causal arm; no functional (force) endpoint.

title: HDAC inhibitors tune miRNAs in extracellular vesicles of dystrophic muscle-resident mesenchymal cells.

causal_test.what: antagomiR-mediated blockade of individual miRs; miR-206 required for EV-induced MuSC expansion and regeneration

limitation.zh: 非辐射营养不良模型；疗效依赖HDACi预处理改变的货物；净效应来自多miR协同。
limitation.en: Non-radiation dystrophy model; efficacy depends on HDACi-shifted cargo; net effect arises from cooperating miRs.

title: Stem Cell-Derived Exosomes Ameliorate Doxorubicin-Induced Muscle Toxicity through Counteracting Pyroptosis.

causal_test.what: MEF-Exo control only; no NLRP3/caspase-1 inhibitor arm

limitation.zh: 非辐射，但属肿瘤治疗相关肌毒性；焦亡关联未经抑制剂验证。
limitation.en: Non-radiation but a cancer-therapy myotoxicity; pyroptosis link not tested with inhibitors.

title: Bone Marrow Stromal Cell-Derived Exosomes Promote Muscle Healing Following Contusion Through Macrophage Polarization.

causal_test.what: clodronate-liposome macrophage depletion abolishes the benefit

limitation.zh: 剂量未报告；未鉴定起效货物。
limitation.en: Dose not reported and the active cargo is not identified.

title: Extracellular vesicles derived from human ESC-MSCs target macrophage and promote anti-inflammation process, angiogenesis, and functional recovery in ACS-induced severe skeletal muscle injury.
model: acute compartment syndrome (ACS)-induced severe skeletal muscle injury

causal_test.what: clodronate-liposome macrophage depletion reduces EV efficacy

limitation.zh: 多miRNA-多通路归因较弱，单一货物未验证；仅3天短期终点。
limitation.en: Attribution across many miRNAs and pathways is weak with no single cargo validated, and the endpoint is only 3 days.

journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: Reciprocal communication between FAPs and muscle cells via distinct extracellular vesicle miRNAs in muscle regeneration.
model: BaCl2 acute injury of tibialis anterior

causal_test.what: RNase-protection test of EV lumen cargo; miR mimics in FAPs; Pdgfrα+ cell depletion (iDTR) context arm

limitation.zh: miR-127-3p的在体敲降未做，疗效来自永生化FAP的EV，与原代FAP可能不同。
limitation.en: No in vivo miR-127-3p knockdown; the therapeutic EVs come from immortalised FAPs, which may differ from primary FAPs.

title: Irradiation of muscle precursor cells impairs the proliferative and angiogenic functions of their extracellular vesicles.
model: radiation (10 Gy X-ray, muscle precursor cells in vitro; irradiated MPC + HUVEC/microvascular fragment assays)
species: rat MPC (donor/recipient); human HUVEC; rat microvascular fragments

causal_test.what: no cargo knockdown, no pathway inhibitor, no EV-depletion rescue; miRNA-pathway link is target prediction only

limitation.zh: 仅体外：无在体辐射肌肉模型，miRNA-通路关联仅为生物信息学预测，未做靶点验证。
limitation.en: In vitro only: no in vivo irradiated-muscle model, and the miRNA-pathway link is bioinformatic prediction without target validation.

title: Regenerative effects of myogenic gene transfected MSC derived exosomes on radiation esophagitis.
model: radiation-induced oesophageal muscle injury/fibrosis (10 Gy × 2 fractions, localized oesophageal irradiation)

causal_test.what: comparison with naive MSC-exo and vector-exo only; no cargo knockdown or pathway inhibitor

limitation.zh: 辐射模型但靶器官为食管（平滑肌为主+部分横纹肌），非四肢骨骼肌；未报告EV剂量、颗粒数与功能学（力学）指标。
limitation.en: Radiation model, but the target is oesophageal muscle (largely smooth muscle with some striated) rather than limb skeletal muscle; EV dose/particle number and functional (force) outcomes are not reported.

title: Myogenic differentiation-derived small extracellular vesicles as a therapeutic strategy for miR-193b-3p-mediated muscle regeneration.
model: volumetric muscle loss (VML) of tibialis anterior
species: mouse (C57BL/6); human skeletal muscle progenitor cells

causal_test.what: AP2M1 knockdown phenocopies; synthetic miR-193b-3p delivery reproduces the effect

limitation.zh: 仅14天单一时点与组织学终点，无力学恢复数据。
limitation.en: Single 14-day timepoint with histology only; no functional force recovery data.
